scenes.name: Cold Open

chapter.zh: 序幕 · 零摄影机，四重尺度

ledger: 2026-11-28 · 539 repositories · ChronoAI Pte. Ltd. 243 (Volumes I, II, IV) · The Omega Institute, independent, 296 (Volume III)
lines: Look at this room in Singapore. Zero cameras behind the glass. Zero agencies polishing a single word.
看看这间新加坡办公室：玻璃后面没有一台摄影机，也没有公关公司润色过半个字。
Everything you are about to watch is running live right now—across five hundred thirty-nine repositories, two 3D worlds, and two hundred twenty-three thousand machine-checked theorems.
你即将看到的一切此刻都在真实运行——横跨五百三十九座代码库、两座 3D 世界，以及二十二万三千条机器核验定理。
Execution just collapsed to zero. Now listen with a hammer to what actually holds weight.
执行的成本刚刚塌向零。现在，拿铁锤听一听，到底什么才真正压得住阵脚。

scenes.name: Through the Glass
ledger: 60 days · 141,624 commits across 74 active repositories
1,108 seats · 4 stands × 8 rows · 18 flower mats
Nov 27 · Donna · 13 requests · 0 dropped seats · median 29 s
lines: Start at Donna's front desk. Eighteen flower mats, Flower Town right around the corner, and a November twenty-seventh rehearsal that booked thirteen requests with zero dropped seats in twenty-nine seconds median.
从 Donna 的前厅开始：十八块花篮垫位、转角就是鲜花小镇，十一月二十七日彩排十三次订座零漏单，中位响应二十九秒。
Now pull straight through the glass—into four floating stands, eight tiered rows, and one thousand one hundred eight atomic-locked seats hovering over Singapore.
现在直接穿破玻璃幕墙——四座悬空看台、八排阶梯、一千一百零八个原子锁席位，正悬停在新加坡上空。
One hundred forty-one thousand commits landed in sixty days—roughly fifteen engineers conducting fleets of agents. Never clap for volume. A flood has volume.
六十天里落下十四万一千次提交，约十五位工程师指挥代理集群推进。别为数量鼓掌——洪水也有数量。

scenes.name: Marina Bay to Orbit
ledger: chrono-metaverse · 14 aircraft · 252.8 m Sky-Screen · 5,307 km orbital screen
lines: Climb past the stadium, bank over Marina Bay Sands and fourteen live broadcast craft, and watch daylight melt into neon across Singapore's skyline.
拉升越过体育场，掠过滨海湾金沙与十四架实时飞行器，看白昼在新加坡天际线滑入夜色霓虹。
Keep climbing until the entire bay shrinks beneath a five-thousand-kilometer orbital screen—four physical scales locked onto one unbroken live signal.
继续攀升，直到整片海湾缩成五千公里轨道大屏脚下的一点微光——四重物理尺度，锁在同一路实时信号上。
Now leave Earth's atmosphere. Because marketing slogans suffocate in vacuum—and only machine-checked proof survives.
现在冲出大气层。因为营销口号会在真空里窒息，唯有机器核验的证明才能活下来。

scenes.name: Eight Stations

chapter.en: Act I — The Omega Institute: Eight Stations into Proof
chapter.zh: 第一幕 · The Omega Institute：穿越星穹，直抵内核

ledger: trureturing @ 548388cd · 223,231 frozen Lean 4 theorems · 17,968 modules · 6.02M LOC
720/720 UTC hours · median 63 commits/hr
2,278 literature resolutions · 1,512 proved / 766 refuted · journals 358 proved + 326 refuted = 684
8 orbital stations · 500 relay arcs · 8 spiral galaxies · 19,022 truth nodes
lines: Welcome to the independent research observatory of The Omega Institute at live dot trureturing dot org—not a product showcase, an open glass anvil.
欢迎来到独立科研机构 The Omega Institute 的 live.trureturing.org——这不是产品展厅，而是一座透明铁砧。
Fire a radar sweep across eight orbital stations, dive straight through the formal verification bridge, and drop into eight spiral galaxies of nineteen thousand living truth nodes.
一道灵识扫频掠过八座空间站，直穿形式验证主桥，坠入由一万九千个活真值节点组成的八座螺旋星系。

Seven hundred twenty straight hours without stopping. Median sixty-three commits an hour. Two hundred twenty-three thousand frozen Lean four theorems and two thousand two hundred seventy-eight literature problems resolved.
连续七百二十小时不停摆，中位每小时六十三次提交，累计二十二万三千条冻结 Lean 4 定理、攻克两千二百七十八道文献难题。

scenes.name: The Lean Kernel
ledger: Fredkin witness · 2.00034 ebits · propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound · sorryAx: 0
ANALOGY · Feynman ratchet
trureturing-books · 344 bilingual pages/language · 83 films · 2,043 distinct theorems
lines: Never trust a narrator. Walk to the blackboard and inspect the chalk. A twenty twenty-five Physical Review A conjecture claimed four-qubit Fredkin gates cap out at two ebits.
别信旁白，走到黑板前查粉笔字。二零二五年 Physical Review A 曾猜想：四量子比特 Fredkin 门的纠缠上限不超过 2 ebits。
One explicit witness shattered it at two point zero zero zero three four ebits. Run #print axioms in Lean four: only propext, Classical.choice, and Quot.sound—zero sorryAx.
一个显式反例以 2.00034 ebits 当场击穿猜想。运行 #print axioms，Lean 4 内核只返回三条标准公理——零 sorryAx。
Like Feynman's tiny ratchet and pawl—an analogy, not a slogan—two frozen theorems lock every step: truth narrows illusion, and old knowledge can never be double-counted as new.
就像费曼的微米棘轮与棘爪——这是类比而非口号——两条冻结定理锁死棘齿：新真理压缩错觉，旧知识永不重复记功。

scenes.name: Red Ink
ledger: 1,049 scholars contacted · 485 replied · 17 arXiv · 21 OEIS · 66 declined
mathesis-papers · 225 open papers · 0 formal peer-review acceptances
Nov 20 · Levent Alpöge released his five-theorem Lean 4.33.1 proof of classical RiemannHypothesis and Dirichlet GRH
Nov 21 · Lean/Mathlib communities certified classical RiemannHypothesis · independent five-theorem audits checked Dirichlet GRH
the-omega-institute/riemann-hypothesis · 8,490-shard ./verify replay · trureturing proves only the integer Hankel equivalence
OPEN · Extended RH · Grand RH · zero simplicity · pair correlation
lines: Here is where every other launch cuts the camera. We stamp the bruises in crimson right next to the trophies. Out of a thousand forty-nine scholars contacted, four hundred eighty-five replied—and sixty-six politely declined.
换作别的发布会，这里早就切镜头了。我们偏把缺口用朱红印在奖杯旁：联络千余位学者，四百八十五位回信，也有六十六位礼貌婉拒。
On Mathesis, two hundred twenty-five open papers carry machine-checkable sources, yet formal peer-review acceptances still read zero. We leave that zero bright red until outside referees change it.
Mathesis 平台已收录两百二十五篇开源论文，但正式同行评审录用数至今仍是零。这枚红灯，留给外部审稿人亲手翻绿。

And we never steal credit. Levent Alpöge released his Lean four proof of the Riemann Hypothesis and Dirichlet GRH on November twentieth, certified by the Lean community on November twenty-first. Omega built the eight-thousand-four-hundred-ninety-shard replay—while Extended RH, Grand RH, zero simplicity, and pair correlation stay unmistakably open.
我们也绝不抢功：Levent Alpöge 于十一月二十日发布黎曼猜想与狄利克雷 GRH 的 Lean 4 证明，社区于二十一日认证古典黎曼猜想；Omega 只认领八千四百九十分片重放工程——而扩展 RH、大 RH、零点简单性与对关联，依然鲜红开放。

scenes.name: The Complete Vehicle

chapter.en: Act II — ChronoAI: The Complete Vehicle Live
chapter.zh: 第二幕 · ChronoAI：整车实测，零密钥底座

ledger: ANALOGY · engine and vehicle · hotel keycard
NyxID v0.78.0 · 55 services · 42 MCP specs · 0 plaintext keys
lines: Step back into daylight and lift the hood. Anyone can rent a five-hundred-horsepower engine by the token today. Bolt that bare engine to wet concrete without brakes or a firewall, and the first tap of throttle is shrapnel.
走回白昼，掀开引擎盖。今天人人都能按次租到五百马力的裸发动机，但把它拧在湿水泥上不装刹车和防火墙，第一脚油门换来的只有碎铁片。
ChronoAI builds the complete vehicle around an engine you can swap tomorrow. Watch NyxID running live—like a hotel keycard that opens room four-twelve until noon and never touches the master safe.
ChronoAI 造的是明天就能整颗换掉发动机、底盘依然稳如磐石的整车。看正在运行的 NyxID——像一张定时门卡，只开 412 房门到中午，永不碰总保险柜。
Fifty-five services, forty-two live MCP specs, instant one-command revocation, and zero plaintext keys ever entering an agent's prompt.
五十五项服务、四十二份线上 MCP 规范、一条命令即时吊销——进入代理上下文的明文密钥数，恒定为零。

scenes.name: The Running Stack
ledger: Ornn v0.18.0 · 163 scanned skills · 134 ops
CMA v0.12.0 · Apache-2.0 · 2.1 s hot credential reload
heca · 27 integrations · 360 nightlies
chrono-harness · 25 public repos · 21 Rust binaries/platform · 540 Verus proofs · Copier v0.1.52
lines: Stack the rest of the vehicle live. Ornn turns fragile prompt folklore into one hundred sixty-three scanned, versioned skills you call like an API.
继续把整车逐层立起来：Ornn 把玄学咒语锻成一百六十三项经扫描的版本化技能，像调 API 一样直接调用。

Apache-licensed CMA zero point twelve runs hosted agents in isolated sandboxes with two-second hot credential reloads—while local canvas heca conducts twenty-seven agent integrations across three hundred sixty nightlies.
Apache 开源的 CMA v0.12.0 在隔离沙箱里托管代理、两秒热重载凭据；本地画布 heca 横跨二十七类代理集成，已迭代三百六十个夜间版本。
And at github dot com slash chrono-harness, twenty-five public repositories replace wishful prompt checklists with twenty-one executable Rust judges and five hundred forty Verus proofs.
而在 github.com/chrono-harness 的二十五座公开仓里，二十一个可执行 Rust 判官与五百四十份 Verus 证明，彻底取代了温柔的提示词祈祷。

scenes.name: Unfinished Steel
ledger: heca source repository private · CMA single primary coding runtime · chrono-harness completeness_proven: false
lines: Every spotless brochure is hiding its weld marks. Look at the three unfinished bolts on our workbench right now: heca's source is still private, CMA runs one primary coding runtime today, and inside chrono-harness, completeness proven still reads false.
凡是毫无焊痕的精美手册，多半藏着裂缝。看我们工作台上三颗还没拧紧的螺丝：heca 源码仍为私有、CMA 目前只跑单一主编码运行时，chrono-harness 里 completeness_proven 至今诚实写着假。
We would rather hand you the caliper and Volume Two than paint over wet steel.
与其给未冷的钢板刷漆，我们更愿意把游标卡尺和第二卷直接递到你手里。

scenes.name: Nine Roles

chapter.en: Act III — Handing the Launch to Nine AI Employees
chapter.zh: 第三幕 · 把发布会交给九位 AI 员工

ledger: 9 standalone AI roles · 102/120 workflows (85.0%) · HR 15 → 14/20 · #9 Retrospective Analyst 11/11
Nov 27 dress rehearsal · 11/12 first try · 4 human taps · Donna median 29 s · NyxID #2534 stalled 65 min, 3 min bypass
Launch Arena · 432/1,108 seated · 0 duplicate seats vs 105 naive
0 external paying merchants · first pilot opens Dec 17
lines: A neighborhood bakery does not need to refute a quantum theorem. On Monday morning it needs nine disciplined roles covering one hundred two of one hundred twenty workflows—hands that freeze at the cash register until a human turns the key.
街角烘焙店不需要去反驳量子猜想。周一早上九点，它只需要九个守规矩的岗位覆盖一百二十项流程中的一百零二项——而且碰到收银台，没有人类拧钥匙就绝不越雷池半步。

Look at the real scars too: our strict audit knocked HR down from fifteen to fourteen when PDF parsing hit limits. In our November twenty-seventh full rehearsal, eleven of twelve stages passed with four human taps—while one stuck queue, logged as NyxID issue twenty-five thirty-four, stalled sixty-five minutes before a three-minute bypass cleared it.
伤疤也照实摊开：严格审计测出简历解析边界，亲手把 HR 从十五项调回十四项；十一月二十七日全流程彩排人类只动了四次手就闯过十一关，唯一卡住六十五分钟的队列被钉成 NyxID #2534，三分钟旁路当场打通。
External paying merchants live today? Zero. No fairy tales—our first pilot cohort opens December seventeenth.
今天上线的外部付费商户有几家？零。不讲童话——第一批商户试点，十二月十七日正式开放申请。

scenes.name: Return Flight

chapter.zh: 终幕 · 双境合一，拿起粉笔

ledger: 8 spiral galaxies · 5,307 km orbit · 252.8 m Sky-Screen · 1,108-seat Tide Arena
lines: Now pull back across both worlds at once—from eight galaxies of frozen mathematics straight down through Earth orbit into Marina Bay's glowing arena.
现在同时拉远两座世界——从八座冻结数学星系穿过地球轨道，一路降回流光溢彩的滨海湾剧场。
Nietzsche wrote that strength is not noise—it is giving form to chaos. Feynman added the first law of honest work: never fool yourself, and you are the easiest person to fool.
尼采说，力量不是喧嚣，而是给混沌赋予形式。费曼补上了诚实造物的第一铁律：绝不能欺骗自己，而你自己恰恰最容易被骗。
What grows rarer with every sunrise is an architecture brave enough to lay its code, its proofs, its downgrades, and its open seams side by side in the sun.
每一个清晨都在变得更稀缺的，是敢把代码、证明、降级账本与未完接缝并排摊在太阳底下的坦荡工程。

scenes.name: Pick Up the Chalk
ledger: ChronoAI Pte. Ltd. · chrono-ai.fun · Street Corner · Dec 17 16:00 SGT · contact@chrono-ai.fun
The Omega Institute · independent · live.trureturing.org · trureturing-books · mathesis-papers
lines: Step into Street Corner on December seventeenth at four p.m. Singapore time. Audit any green theorem at live dot trureturing dot org. Open all four monographs, or write to contact at chrono-ai dot fun.
十二月十七日下午四点（新加坡时间），推开街角前厅的门；去 live.trureturing.org 抽检任意一条绿标定理；翻开这四部公开专著，或致信 contact@chrono-ai.fun。
Pick up the chalk—build for what comes next.
拿起粉笔——面向未来去造物。
